card.name: Dose calculation steps before volume
card.fires_on: The word "the" after Calculate or Determine, or "equals"/"=" after a volume formula, in dose preparation instructions. Also a digit in a concentration like 0.8 mL.

modes.label: After Calculate/Determine
modes.description: The word "the" right after a verb telling the reader to calculate or determine a volume, dose or number of vials.
modes.example: by the patient weight in kilograms. Calculate<< the>> required volume in milliliters of AN

modes.label: Volume formula sign
modes.description: An equals sign or the word equals after a volume-to-administer label in a formula.
modes.example: Volume to be administered (mL)<< =>> Body weight in kg × 1.

modes.label: Concentration digit
modes.description: A digit inside a strength-per-volume figure in a dosing table.

card.writes: It pushes toward words asking how much, amount and difference, as in calculating a quantity.
card.plain: It lights up where the label tells you to work out how much volume or dose to prepare.
